items.markdown: Added [FMHY Plugin](https://www.flowlauncher.com/plugins/fmhy-search-3f7a2b1c-9e4d-4f8a-b3c2-1a5d8e7f0b9c) to [Flow Launcher](https://www.flowlauncher.com/). Thank you to @finn for making this.
Added section for [Kindle Tools](https://fmhy.net/reading#kindle-tools) to Reading. Thank you to @Dan & @Kiwi Kitten for making this.
Added section for [P-Stream Forks](https://fmhy.net/video#p-stream-forks) to Streaming.
Added section for [Chromium Tools](https://fmhy.net/internet-tools#chromium-tools) to Internet Tools.
Added section for [World Data](https://fmhy.net/educational#world-data) to Humanities. Thank you to to @hiz for the idea.
Added section for [Vexillology / Flags](https://fmhy.net/educational#vexillology-flags) to Humanities. Thank you to @MTG for collecting resources.

Separated [Aerospace Engineering](https://fmhy.net/educational#aerospace-engineering) into subsections: [Rocketry](https://fmhy.net/educational#rocketry) / [Drones](https://fmhy.net/educational#drones) / [Simulators](https://fmhy.net/educational#simulators). Thank you to @yeet for collecting sites + @tomato for the idea.

Re-organized [Video Player](https://fmhy.net/video-tools#video-players) section + moved both MPV + MPC-HC above MPC-QT, as people don't feel its ease of use outweighs its potential issues or missing features (like config support). [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/ksvk9R6C/1231234234.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/HBp3zGh.png)

Added Platform Icons to [Remote Desktop](https://fmhy.net/system-tools#remote-desktop) + [Clipboard Managers](https://fmhy.net/system-tools#clipboard-managers), thank you to @zinklog for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/20Bb7MF3/3453456.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/m0R8QzX.png)

Added Platform Icons to [Email Clients](https://fmhy.net/internet-tools#email-clients), thank you to @draven for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/8gCfmYnF/354756uj.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/ATMzFBm.png)
Added Platform Icons to [Chat Tools](https://fmhy.net/internet-tools#chat-tools), thank you to @waflenoob for doing this.
Improved the UI of the [Posts Page](https://fmhy.net/posts), thank you to @cufiy for doing this. [Before vs After](https://i.ibb.co/dJQxgMk8/image.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/CzMIKFG.png)
Added 2 new FMHY dupe link checkers: [Link Checker](https://link-checker-215e95.gitlab.io/) + [FMHY Check](https://fmhycheck.vercel.app/), thank you to @cufiy & @casmay for making these.
Starred [ArchiveTune](https://fmhy.net/mobile#youtube-music) in Android YouTube Music Apps, has a nice UI and seems to work well for people.
Starred [Too Good To Go](https://fmhy.net/misc#food) in Food section, good way to get cheap food, and prevent food waste, worked well for our members who tried it.
Starred [Hardcover](https://fmhy.net/reading#tracking-database) in Reading Tracking / Databases, has a nice UI, lots of features, and ability to import from other platforms (like goodreads).
Starred [Yasosu](https://fmhy.net/text-tools#pastebins) in Pastebins, has markdown support, allows editing posts, and has custom URLs.
Starred [The Criterion Closet](https://fmhy.net/video#curated-recommendations) in Curated Recommendations, 3D Criterion walk-in closet recreation with filters.
Starred [LibrePods](https://fmhy.net/linux-macos#linux-audio) in Linux Audio, allows you to use AirPod features on Linux (and android rooted).
Starred [SeaDex](https://fmhy.net/video#anime-torrenting) in Anime Torrenting, anime video quality guide, can be used in combination with things like Stremio + AIOStream.
Starred [LACT](https://fmhy.net/linux-macos#linux-system) in Linux System, feature-rich GPU config + monitor, simplified overclocking.
Starred [Unsloth](https://fmhy.net/ai#machine-learning) in Machine Learning, easy to use finetuning + AI suite, seems to be well liked.
Starred [Zperiod](https://fmhy.net/educational#periodic-tables) in Periodic Tables, clean interactive periodic table w/ 3D atom models.
[Bookracy](https://fmhy.net/reading#ebooks) is back and has been re-added & re-starred in Ebook section.
Both [Soft98 + DownloadHa](https://fmhy.net/downloading#software-sites) are working again, they've been re-added & re-starred in the software section.
Unstarred GOG-Games as they're [shutting down](https://i.ibb.co/6JyJQjZz/345.png) / [2](https://i.imgur.com/KXJMdAr.png) in 90 days.
